notes.title: Update Ui
notes.notes: Hello, This is minor update it will update UI of the game. About 70% of UI is updated few panels should be updated tomorrow. It looks much better than previous version, Once I am done with this I am hoping to finish character dynamics by april 3rd.

notes.title: Bugfixes and new changes
notes.notes:
Following is a long list of changes I made yesterday and today, Fixed many crucial bugs also added a few small features.

[olist]
[*] Now you can set when to end comic production(basically end series with last comic).
[*] Fixed sequel name.
[*] Fixed duplicate listing of characters.
[*] Changed text in tutorials.
[*] Fixed numerous bugs in the research topic panel.
[*] Now it needs at least one employee to make any comic.
[*] Players point generation is now balanced.
[*] Unlockables: Scale is now unlockable features new scales will be added periodically.
[*] Added another hint in slider's windows(  ,-,=) etc.
[*] character limit for sequels.
[*] Fixed issue when developing multiple comics together.
[*] Multiple comic is now locked feature, It will be unlocked when players reach the last office.
[*] Bugs in character listing.
[*] Resizable window screen is now available.
[*] Added scrollbar's
[*] Fixed employee relations.
[*] Fixed issue with double assigning artists.
[*] Description and character name character limit(All thank's to GrayStillPlays)
[*] Numerous other small changes and fixes.
[/olist]

notes.title: Bugfixes and Features added
notes.notes:
Hello, I updated game 6-7 times today. I just released the final update for today. Now I am working on adding tooltip's and improving tutorial section. 

[list]
[*] Ability to edit character.
[*] Now games show review panel more in-depth.
[*] Ability to select starting money.
[*] Optimized sell algorithm.
[*] Added monthly office cost(3k).
[*] Window Mode.
[*] Pause game by pressing P.
[*] Fixed punctuations errors.
[*] Added more topics at the start.
[*] Now With Action and Drama, Comedy genre is also unlocked at start.
[*] Set founder's type.
[*] Fixed bug in topic research menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date and Beta test
notes.notes: Hello, My target was to release the game on 9th of march but more I play the game it feels like something is missing. I don't think it is well balanced, Also I don't want to release half baked product on steam that is why I need your help I am hosting beta on itch io. If anyone is interested in testing it please contact me. I will send them demo-key.
